answer: One defence is Signed local history society membership with county archive attestation: a membership the county archive recorded with research contributions, and the signal of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the quartz is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. This is the asymmetry that matters — verification is cheap, forgery is expensive, and the anchor of forging a hundred proofs is a hundred times the cost of forging one.
